recentItems.title: Will Alberta’s dual-practice doctors cut wait times for all — or just those who pay?
recentItems.description:
Alberta has introduced a dual-practice health-care model that allows surgeons to work in public hospitals while performing paid surgeries on the side. The promise is that it will open up capacity, but critics warn it mimics a Quebec model that failed to clear backlogs and risks leaving some patients waiting even longer in pain.

recentItems.title: N.B. becomes 1st province to build AI into K-12 curriculum
recentItems.description:
New Brunswick incorporated AI into its school curriculum from kindergarten to Grade 12, the first province in Canada to do so — though younger kids will have limited exposure. Some parents and experts are concerned about the introduction of AI to classrooms amid wider fears over its increasing sophistication and rapid development.
